title: Behavioral Segmentation — Overview
summary: Dividing markets by how customers actually behave: usage, loyalty, occasions, and benefits sought.
body:
Dividing markets by how customers actually behave: usage, loyalty, occasions, and benefits sought. Often the most actionable base.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include RFM Analysis, Cohort Analysis, Loyalty Programs.
